exposure: egg, milk, and milk product consumption
cohort: Pregnant women attending antenatal and delivery services at governmental hospitals of Bahir Dar city.
finding: Being primiparous, having a family history of hypertension, previous history of pre-eclampsia, fewer antenatal care visits, not taking iron and folic acid supplements, higher body mass index, and lower consumption of vegetables, eggs, milk, and milk products were associated with pre-eclampsia.
